maria: Quick heads-up — Kappa-3B v1 weights landed in s3: s3://redwood-models/kappa/3b/v1. Need a quick pass for gates: weights perms, tokenizer mapping, and a small kv-cache config before we flip the canary.

ajay: Thx. Can you paste the S3 path + checksum? also want to confirm the IAM role that will access it.

maria: Path above. sha256: 3b9f7c2a2d1f4e9b6c8a7d4f9b5e2c1f6a7d8e9f0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1
Code to validate quickly:
```
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-models/kappa/3b/v1/weights.pt
sha256sum weights.pt | awk '{print $1}'
```
IAM: inference-role-prod should have GetObject on that prefix. ajay can you confirm?

ajay: confirmed inference-role-prod has GetObject on s3://redwood-models/kappa/3b/* . will run a quick fetch from staging cluster.

taylor: quick note on tokenizer: I saw the model producing broken structured outputs when input contains repeated rare tokens — looks like the special-token mapping isn't being applied for the legacy tokenizer. Example: tokenization of "<|user|>\n<|user|>" -> [50256, 0, 50256] instead of expected [50256, 50256].
Repro snippet:
```
>>> tokenizer.encode("<|user|>\n<|user|>")
[50256, 0, 50256]
```

cheng: that 0 is the placeholder for unknown; sounds like the tokenizer config didn't include the multi-char special token mapping. Update suggestion for model config (serving):
```
model:
  name: kappa-3b
  tokenizer:
    type: byte-level-bpe
    special_tokens:
      - { token: "<|user|>", id: 50256 }
    add_prefix_space: true
```
Can someone add this to the onboarding config under infra/onnboard/kappa-3b/tokenizer.yaml?

maria: Adding now. Also: for structured tool-calls we need to lock the schema — golden tools expect: {"tool":"search","args":{"q":"..."},"result":{...}} exactly. If the tokenizer inserts stray newlines it breaks the JSON parse in the eval harness.
Golden sample we use in regressions:
```
{"tool":"lookup_person","args":{"id":1234},"result":{"name":"Pat Lee","email":"pat@example.com"}}
```

ajay: I'll run the goldset regression after tokenizer change. Where do you want the eval config? under model-evals/kappa-3b/?

maria: Yes — put gold prompts in model-evals/kappa-3b/gold_prompts.jsonl and the expected structured outputs in model-evals/kappa-3b/gold_expected.jsonl. Use the ci/regression runner: `./ci/run_regression --model kappa-3b --gold model-evals/kappa-3b`

deploy-bot: Canary started: deployment=kappa-3b canary=dedicated-pool-3 nodes=2 id=canary-1712230000

taylor: pinging for a quick PR review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/812 — adds tokenizer mapping + goldset path. Small change.

cheng: quick runtime note: kv_cache_max_seq default is 4096; for kappa with long contexts we should set 8192 to avoid cache truncation in canary. Change in serving config: `runtime.kv_cache_max_seq: 8192`. Ajay — can you apply in the canary config?

ajay: will update canary config and restart the worker pool. running smoke with toolcall tests now:
```
# smoke: simple toolcall flow
curl -s -X POST https://canary.dedicated.internal/v1/generate -d '{"input":"Find person id 1234 and return as toolcall"}' | jq '.'
```

taylor: just did a quick review on that PR: LGTM, left one tiny comment about docs. :+1:

maria: Amazing — once ajay posts the regression results, we can decide whether to promote. If regressions pass I want a 1-hour canary then rollout. Thanks all. :seedling:

ajay: regression run finished — no structured-output regressions on goldset, one minor tokenizer whitespace diff (non-blocking). Posting artifacts: s3://redwood-ci-artifacts/kappa-3b/regs/1712230000/results.html

maria: Perfect. I'll start the 1-hour canary monitoring. If anyone sees a spike in parse errors ping here.

taylor: will monitor logs and the structured-output error rate dashboard.

cheng: FYI updated runtime config applied. kv_cache_max_seq=8192.

maria: closing the loop — thanks everyone, great async collab.
